message: 赤いもの
The grass and trees rustle softly in the breeze blowing in from the sea. A plaza on high ground, surrounded by lush foliage.

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, when this sea breeze blows... it's almost that time, isn't it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Time for what?」

name: Synn
message: 「That would be--」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Phew... Oh, it's just you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey there. Are you meeting up with someone?」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I am not waiting for Lolotte or anything!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, really?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte wanted to become friends with you, Azel, so she often came to see you with sweets in hand, right? And didn't the two of you chat together?」

name: Azel
message: 「Wrong. I was merely followed around one-sidedly.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-umm, even after you become friends, you can still get along just like you have been, you know?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm telling you that's wrong.」

name: Azel
message: 「Lolotte had become estranged from her companions and was looking for a way to reconcile with them.」

name: Azel
message: 「However, just a moment ago, she came to report that she had successfully made up with them.」
Could it be about Amyrina?

name: Azel
message: 「If Lolotte comes to see me right now, it would mean their relationship has fallen apart again.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's right.」
A warm, fuzzy feeling washes over me. Azel really cares about Lolotte in her own way, doesn't she.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, maybe Lolotte will bring that girl along and come invite you out, Azel? The more friends, the better, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that how it works?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's right.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Should I go call Lolotte?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Shut up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then what are you doing out here, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「I told you to shut up.」

name: Azel
message: 「From this moment on, I shall commence the consumption of Vandine Jelly right here.」

name: Synn
message: 「O-oh, your favorite jelly that you're always eating, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「Yes, and no. I do not particularly like it. It is purely for rational nutrient intake.」

name: Azel
message: 「While eating, my mouth will be occupied, rendering conversation with you impossible.」
Before even finishing half of it, Azel pulls her mouth away from the jelly. It doesn't seem like she's just catching her breath.

name: Azel
message: 「I do not understand.」

name: Azel
message: 「I heard that eating while in this mental state makes food taste better than usual.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yet it tastes the same.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe you're just tired of eating it? It's always the exact same jelly, after all.」

name: Azel
message: 「Impossible. They are not the same.」

name: Azel
message: 「Vandine Vitamin Jelly: Grape Flavor, Vandine Fiber Jelly: Muscat Flavor.」

name: Azel
message: 「Vandine Energy Jelly: Red Grape Flavor, Vandine Collagen Jelly: White Grape Flavor, Vandine Mineral Jelly: Seedless Grape Flavor.」

name: Azel
message: 「With such an abundant variety, growing tired of them is out of the question.」

name: Synn
message: 「Jelly is still jelly, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「More importantly, how about some raspberries? They're growing around here right about now.」

name: Azel
message: 「What is a raspberry?」

name: Synn
message: 「Rather than explaining, it'd probably be quicker to just have you eat one.」

name: Synn
message: 「Around here... found one!」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you saying that red thing composed of small spherical objects irregularly bonded together is delicious?」

name: Synn
message: 「I think there's a bit of a misunderstanding... The shape and color don't matter.」

name: Synn
message: 「There are lots of different kinds of raspberries, so depending on the season, yellow ones grow too.」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you saying that red and yellow things composed of small spherical objects irregularly bonded together are delicious?」

name: Synn
message: 「You'll know whether it's good or not once you eat it. Here, say 'aah'」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I can eat it myself!」

name: Azel
message: 「*Chomp*」

name: Azel
message: 「Mm... hmm? Is this sensation... what it means to be delicious?」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't answer that for you. Everyone has their own tastes.」

name: Azel
message: 「I wish to eat more to verify. Where are the raspberries?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh... Don't rush, we have to search steadily.」
It's a hidden gem of a spot. Several students seem to have visited already, leaving the surroundings looking like an old path covered in tree roots and leaves.

name: Synn
message: 「If we go into those thickets over there, there's plenty growing, but the raspberry stems have lots of thorns, so it's dangerous.」

name: Azel
message: 「Understood. Over there, then.」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, it's dangerous!」

name: Azel
message: 「If I watch out for the thorns, there will be no issue.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why is Tontoro in a place like this!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Come to think of it, Lolotte left it behind earlier.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't believe she'd let Tontoro out of her sight!」

name: Azel
message: 「It is only temporary.」

name: Azel
message: 「She declared she'd pick both hands full of red things to celebrate making up, and went into the bushes.」
From inside the bushes, an arrow with Scotch tape tied to it comes flying out and pierces the ground.
Lolotte will be safe. As long as Riesling is with her, there's no way she'll get hurt by any thorns.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, how about we fix it? While eating some of the raspberries around here.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Understood.」
By the time Tontoro was restored to its original shape, Azel had eaten more than ten raspberries.
However, it seemed she couldn't quite be sure whether they were good or not.
